title: Extended family tree
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Common vocabulary: personal pronouns, my family, adjectives and moods
source: Written for arabic/y7 lesson 19 (Pupil PDF worksheet: extended family tree)
intro: Lesson 19: My extended family: uncles, aunts and cousins. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Cousins
points: اِبْنُ عَمِّي: my cousin (son of my father's brother)
بِنْتُ خَالَتِي: my cousin (daughter of my mother's sister)

panels.title: Keeping ties
points: Islam teaches keeping family ties (صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ)
Allah loves those who keep ties

box.title: Four sentences, for example: عِنْدِي خَالَانِ

questions.q: Say: my father's brother is a doctor.
Extended family tree on the pupil PDF (boxes and words): add عَمّ، عَمَّة، خَال، خَالَة and two cousins, then write four sentences (e.g. عِنْدِي خَالَانِ).
Extend: one sentence on how you keep family ties.
questions.a: For example: أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي كُلَّ أُسْبُوعٍ.

questions.q: Stretch: say 'my cousin' (daughter of my father's brother).

questions.a: A) خَالَة. Mother's side: خَال / خَالَة.

questions.q: Think again: one word or two for uncle?
questions.a: Two is clearer: it shows which side of the family.
